propositions: When a Jira issue moves between projects, its KEY changes while its numeric id remains immutable, but the old key may fail to resolve if third-party movers do not update the moved_issue_key table, causing bindings keyed on the old key to silently detach from live issues.

The binding store must record and fallback to the numeric jira_id when a key-based lookup fails, re-keying the binding to the issue's current key and updating the reverse index atomically to prevent silent orphaning.
The id-based fallback mechanism must not be attempted while the key resolves normally, so the happy path incurs no extra cost, and must degrade safely on pre-existing bindings with no recorded id.

A moved issue resolves transparently via moved_issue_key table on DC 8.17.1 (status 200 with new key in body), but the id fallback provides defense against third-party movers that fail to update that table and leave the old key unresolvable.

The fix is additive and does not change the shared Cloud binding store identity semantics, rewrite the reverse index path, or require migration, preserving existing jira_key-taking method signatures and behavior.
